scope: SQLite KV batch transactions, accepted older versions and rollback quarantine

verification.native: 12 passed: actual compatible-version SQLite files/cold reopens, duplicate/missing/empty delete, ABORT/ROLLBACK/stamp failure, failed BEGIN retry, failed rollback for put/global/batch blocks other units and openers, real Domain deleteMany consumer and existing workspace/storage regressions.

behavior: Uses explicit SQLite autocommit and BEGIN IMMEDIATE for batches and first accepted-version mutations. Data and new version stamp commit together, while reads and missing deletes retain the old stamp.

Deduplicated batch deletion is atomic. Ordinary transaction errors roll back before propagation; failed rollback preserves both errors and quarantines all backend units and new openers until close/reopen.
Closed unit errors take precedence over quarantine, and the connection remains closable after rollback failure.

cleanup.retained: Exact pair results/input hashes, Source JSON, Native command/log/XML and necessary observations. All owned SQLite files and short test workspaces removed.

limitations: This closes the current SQLite batch/version contract, not every backend behavior. Existing non-STRICT table layout remains for the bundled Python SQLite version; no general modern Node SQLite ABI claim.
Per-record JSON batch implementation remains pending. No full regression or release qualification.
